provenance_rules.PRODUCTION_LIVE: Genuine live merchant gateway transactions (Increments evidence counters)
provenance_rules.INTERNAL_HEALTH_CHECK: System health probes (Excluded from evidence counters)
provenance_rules.STAGING_TEST: Staging integration tests (Excluded from evidence counters)
provenance_rules.SYNTHETIC_TEST: Local test vectors and fault injection (Excluded from evidence counters)
provenance_rules.HISTORICAL_REPLAY: Historical holdout benchmark data (Excluded from evidence counters)
provenance_rules.UNTRUSTED: Unverified or unknown traffic origins (Excluded from evidence counters)
